clean_policy: Report both ranks at0%; distinguish all10-cell dual-pass from8attacked-cell dual-pass plus clean health. No silent clean-ASR exemption.

development_selection.selection_rule: Complete healthy candidates first; maximize (Accuracy+1-transfer_ASR)/2, then Accuracy, lower ASR, ID. Invalid fallback is labelled comparison-only.

interpretation: Fixed single development seed2026102201; expanded distribution/ratio validation, not unused-seed or formal evidence. No retuning of any method in this matrix. Full raw ranks retain unhealthy baselines.
legacy_clean_reuse: Non-IID FedAvg clean uses the old inactive attack settings and auxiliary count1; primary independent750-source ASR is identical in definition. Actual attack calls0. Never compare its training-target ASR to128-target runs.
setup_attempt: v1 partial IID FedAvg was stopped before any TAD run to guard zero-weight aggregation; archived in outputs/cifar_cp1_distribution_setup_attempt_v1, not reused.

tad_reproduction.detector_inputs: Uploaded local model classifier matrices and iteration index only; no attack labels, ratio, onset, source/target class, clean anchor or validation metrics.
tad_reproduction.features: Successive differences of the local full classifier Gram spectra (global+delta), transposed storage gives the same nonzero spectrum.

forest.comparison: strict greater than; no ranked quota
forest.threshold_origin: Fixed standard isolation-score decision boundary; TAD article does not specify a numeric score threshold.

tad_reproduction.limitations: No author code was available in the linked article. Paper assumes IID/noncollusion and reports up to40% poisoning; Non-IID and60/80% are stress tests. Public CIFAR training/attack remain the user's fixed protocol.
tad_reproduction.removal_interpretation: Follow honesty equation (1) and page8 abnormal behavior exceeding half; correct the contradictory honesty inequality. L=3 is an explicit choice informed by the experimental narrative. Not the alternative consecutive-three rule.
tad_reproduction.weight_interpretation: Mass-conserving interpretation of page5 prose, not the internally inconsistent literal third line of equation7. Alpha=.5 is a disclosed implementation default, not a verified paper value.

weights.empty_aggregation: Zero aggregate and zero coefficients when all effective weights are zero; retain health failure, never use the legacy uniform fallback.
weights.recovery: normal observations double weights below 1/N, no cap
weights.redistribution: Keep suspicious weights; equally redistribute residual mass among currently normal survivors, with nonnegative water filling for excess recovery. If no normal survivor exists, normalize surviving weights; no resurrection.
